editorial:
Imagine being a total workaholic single mom who just wants one quiet weekend to relax. That is exactly where you find Lauren, but her plans for peace are ruined when she meets Ben. He is a sweet single dad who needs a huge favor involving a tiny, fluffy Corgi puppy. The vibe here is pure comfort food; it is the kind of movie that feels like a warm blanket and a cup of cocoa. You will quickly fall for the chemistry between the two leads as they juggle the chaos of parenting and puppy training during the busiest time of the year.

What really makes this work is the cute dog and the slow-burn romance. While the plot is predictable and the pacing is a bit slow in the middle, it is exactly what you want from a holiday flick. If you love cheesy stories with happy endings, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Lauren finally decides to put her phone away and prioritize her daughter and her own happiness over her job. Ben and Lauren realize they are perfect for each other, and they decide to start a relationship. The Corgi puppy becomes the glue that brings their two families together. It ends with a big, happy holiday celebration where everyone is smiling and the puppy is officially part of the family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute dogs and lighthearted holiday romances.
